---
title: "Heart phase figures: separate, balanced panels"
date: "2026-10-23"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
---

This is a plotting-only companion to the complete heart analysis. It reads the
completed heart results and a read-only plotting reference. No phase inference,
gene fitting, CellAlign alignment, rho testing, or DTW calculation is repeated.
The previous heart exports and the reference script/results are not overwritten.

The reference supplies typography, plotting forms and a coordinated palette,
not a mandatory tall outer canvas. Following the latest layout request, the
heart panels are exported separately at balanced aspect ratios. They are not
compressed into a shared contact sheet or combined main figure. All ten cell
types are retained. I and S11C remain deferred.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, echo = TRUE, fig.retina = 2)
```

# 1. Saved input and display settings

```{r aligned_input}
heart_root <- "/path/to/analysis_home/scRhythmBayes/data/scHeart_ACR_NCR_new_20261022"
heart_saved_dir <- file.path(heart_root, "figures_complete_noif_20261023")
heart_aligned_dir <- file.path(heart_root, "figures_fly_style_separate_20261023")
heart_reference_rmd <- "/path/to/analysis_home/scRhythmBayes/GSE157504_validation/GSE157504_LD_scRhythmBayes_validation.Rmd"
heart_code_dir <- "/path/to/scRhythmBayes/reproducibility/05_heart"
heart_reference_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(heart_reference_rmd))

heart_packages <- c("dplyr", "readr", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "ComplexHeatmap",
                    "circlize", "RColorBrewer", "grid", "gridExtra", "tibble", "jsonlite", "ragg", "svglite")
stopifnot(all(vapply(heart_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)))
grDevices::pdfFonts(Arial = grDevices::pdfFonts("ArialMT")[[1]])
dir.create(heart_aligned_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
source(file.path(heart_code_dir, "measure_aligned_heart_panels_20261023.R"))
source(file.path(heart_code_dir, "measure_heart_panels_20261023.R"))
source("/path/to/scRhythmBayes/R/plot_dtw_heatmap.R")

heart_saved <- readRDS(file.path(heart_saved_dir, "completed_plot_objects.rds"))
heart_rho <- readRDS(file.path(heart_saved_dir, "heart_run_phase_rho.rds"))
heart_dtw <- readRDS(file.path(heart_saved_dir, "heart_run_dtw_similarity.rds"))
heart_density <- readr::read_tsv(
  file.path(heart_saved_dir, "Main_E_circular_density.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE
)
heart_celltypes <- names(heart_saved$F_individual)
stopifnot(length(heart_celltypes) == 10L, nrow(heart_density) == 14400L)
stopifnot(nrow(heart_dtw$similarity) == 20L)
heart_density_counts <- heart_density |> dplyr::distinct(.data$celltype, .data$Group, .data$n_cells)
stopifnot(sum(heart_density_counts$n_cells) == 127942L)

heart_group_fill <- c(NCR = "#D7E8F0", ACR = "#E9D5E3")
heart_group_line <- c(NCR = "#5F8EA3", ACR = "#A17494")
heart_zt_fill <- stats::setNames(unname(heart_group_fill), c("ZT08", "ZT16"))
heart_zt_line <- stats::setNames(unname(heart_group_line), c("ZT08", "ZT16"))
heart_preview_dpi <- 120L
heart_celltype_cols <- c(
  Cardiomyocytes = "#E64B35", Endothelial = "#4DBBD5",
  Lymphocytes = "#00A087", Myeloid = "#3C5488", Adipocytes = "#F39B7F",
  Neuron = "#8491B4", Pericytes = "#91D1C2", SMC = "#DC0000",
  Fibroblasts = "#7E6148", Myofibroblasts = "#B09C85"
)
heart_sizes <- data.frame(
  panel = c("E", "F", "G", "H", "S11A", "S11B"),
  width_in = c(9.2, 13.5, 9.8, 11.8, 11, 11),
  height_in = c(8.2, 9.4, 8.8, 5.6, 5.5, 5.3)
)
readr::write_tsv(heart_sizes, file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "panel_dimensions.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(data.frame(
  dataset = c("Heart", "Heart", "Fly", "Fly"),
  group = c("NCR", "ACR", "LD", "DD"),
  fill = c(unname(heart_group_fill), "#D8EADE", "#D5CAE3"),
  line = c(unname(heart_group_line), "#688B78", "#7C6B91")
), file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "group_palette.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(data.frame(
  label = names(heart_zt_fill), fill = unname(heart_zt_fill), line = unname(heart_zt_line)
), file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "True_ZT_palette.tsv"))

heart_export_plot <- function(plot, name, width, height) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(heart_aligned_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
                 width = width, height = height, device = grDevices::cairo_pdf, bg = "white")
  svglite::svglite(file.path(heart_aligned_dir, paste0(name, ".svg")), width = width, height = height)
  grid::grid.draw(plot)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(heart_aligned_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
                 width = width, height = height, dpi = 600, device = ragg::agg_png, bg = "white")
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(heart_aligned_dir, paste0(name, "_preview.png")), plot,
                 width = width, height = height, dpi = heart_preview_dpi, device = ragg::agg_png, bg = "white")
}
```

# 2. E: overlapping circular-density ridges

The saved circular KDE is unchanged (bandwidth 0.35, 720 grid points). As in
the reference, each curve is normalized to its own peak for display. Ridge
height is therefore not cell abundance or a directly comparable density peak.
The original absolute KDE remains available in the source table.

```{r aligned_E, fig.width=9.2, fig.height=8.2}
heart_E_order <- rev(levels(heart_saved$E$data$ridge_id))
heart_E_order <- unique(sub(" [|] .*", "", heart_E_order))
stopifnot(setequal(heart_E_order, heart_celltypes))
heart_ridge <- heart_density |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$celltype, .data$Group) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ridge_height = .data$density / max(.data$density),
    baseline = match(.data$celltype, rev(heart_E_order))
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(.data$Group, levels = c("NCR", "ACR")))

p_heart_E <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  heart_ridge, ggplot2::aes(x = .data$theta, group = interaction(.data$celltype, .data$Group))
) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(
    ymin = .data$baseline, ymax = .data$baseline + 0.90 * .data$ridge_height, fill = .data$Group
  ), alpha = 0.65) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(ggplot2::aes(
    y = .data$baseline + 0.90 * .data$ridge_height, colour = .data$Group
  ), linewidth = 0.72) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = heart_group_fill, name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = heart_group_line, name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, pi / 2, pi, 3 * pi / 2, 2 * pi),
    labels = c("0", "π/2", "π", "3π/2", "2π"), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(heart_E_order), labels = rev(heart_E_order),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = c(0.2, 1.0))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Phase (rad)", y = NULL) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 16, base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "top", legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.line.y = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 14, 10, 10)
  )
heart_export_plot(p_heart_E, "Heart_E_phase_density", 9.2, 8.2)
readr::write_tsv(heart_ridge, file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_E_display_data.tsv"))
p_heart_E
```

# 3. F: saved local costs, four columns

The saved local-cost matrices and gray warping paths are unchanged. Only the
canvas, typography and arrangement are changed. The last row contains two
plots and two empty slots; no cell types are omitted.

```{r aligned_F, fig.width=13.5, fig.height=9.4}
heart_F_panels <- lapply(heart_saved$F_individual, function(p) {
  p$coordinates <- ggplot2::coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE)
  p + ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(
    barheight = grid::unit(1.8, "cm"), barwidth = grid::unit(0.18, "cm"),
    title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0, ticks = FALSE
  )) + ggplot2::theme(
    text = ggplot2::element_text(family = "sans"),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.08, "cm"),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(7, 3, 7, 3),
    plot.background = ggplot2::element_blank(), panel.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    legend.background = ggplot2::element_blank(), legend.box.background = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )
})
p_heart_F <- patchwork::wrap_plots(heart_F_panels, ncol = 4)
heart_F_ids <- paste0("p", seq_len(10))
measure_aligned_heart_panels(
  patchwork::patchworkGrob(p_heart_F), file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_F_CellAlign"),
  13.5, 9.4, "^panel(-[0-9]+)?[.]", heart_F_ids,
  list(heart_F_ids[1:4], heart_F_ids[5:8], heart_F_ids[9:10]),
  list(heart_F_ids[c(1, 5, 9)], heart_F_ids[c(2, 6, 10)],
       heart_F_ids[c(3, 7)], heart_F_ids[c(4, 8)])
)
heart_export_plot(p_heart_F, "Heart_F_CellAlign", 13.5, 9.4)
for (celltype in heart_celltypes) {
  heart_export_plot(heart_F_panels[[celltype]], paste0("Heart_F_", celltype), 3.6, 3.6)
}
p_heart_F
```

# 4. G: square heatmap body with the reference plotting interface

The 20 by 20 similarity matrix is unchanged. Its within-matrix normalization
does not support absolute comparison with similarity values in another dataset.

```{r aligned_G, fig.width=9.8, fig.height=8.8}
heart_ht <- plot_dtw_heatmap(
  dtw_res = heart_dtw, matrix_type = "similarity",
  cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = TRUE, show_column_names = FALSE,
  group_colors = heart_group_fill, celltype_colors = heart_celltype_cols,
  title = "DTW-based Similarity",
  width = grid::unit(12.5, "cm"), height = grid::unit(12.5, "cm")
)
heart_ht$heatmap@heatmap_param$show_heatmap_legend <- FALSE
heart_similarity_legend <- ComplexHeatmap::Legend(
  title = "Similarity", col_fun = heart_ht$heatmap@matrix_color_mapping@col_fun,
  at = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5", "1"),
  title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 13), title_gap = grid::unit(4, "mm"),
  legend_height = grid::unit(5, "cm")
)
for (format in c("pdf", "svg", "png")) {
  heart_G_device <- list(pdf = grDevices::cairo_pdf, svg = svglite::svglite,
                         png = ragg::agg_png)[[format]]
  heart_G_arguments <- list(
    pdf = list(filename = file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_G_DTW_similarity.pdf"), width = 9.8, height = 8.8),
    svg = list(file = file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_G_DTW_similarity.svg"), width = 9.8, height = 8.8),
    png = list(filename = file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_G_DTW_similarity.png"), width = 9.8, height = 8.8, units = "in", res = 600)
  )[[format]]
  do.call(heart_G_device, heart_G_arguments)
  ComplexHeatmap::draw(heart_ht$heatmap, merge_legends = TRUE,
                       heatmap_legend_list = list(heart_similarity_legend),
                       heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right",
                       padding = grid::unit(c(6, 4, 4, 4), "mm"))
  grDevices::dev.off()
}
ragg::agg_png(file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_G_DTW_similarity_preview.png"),
              width = 9.8, height = 8.8, units = "in", res = heart_preview_dpi)
ComplexHeatmap::draw(heart_ht$heatmap, merge_legends = TRUE,
                     heatmap_legend_list = list(heart_similarity_legend),
                     heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right",
                     padding = grid::unit(c(6, 4, 4, 4), "mm"))
grDevices::dev.off()
```

# 5. H: reference styling on a wider, shorter canvas

All saved patient rho values, sample-quality thresholds, raw P values, BH
corrections and labels are retained. The y axis is 0--100%, with annotations
above 100%, as in the reference. No test is recalculated.

```{r aligned_H, fig.width=11.8, fig.height=5.6}
heart_H_data <- heart_rho$rho_sample |>
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$rho)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(rho_percent = 100 * .data$rho, Group = factor(.data$Group, levels = c("NCR", "ACR")))
heart_H_order <- heart_H_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$cell_type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(rho_mean = mean(.data$rho), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(.data$rho_mean)) |>
  dplyr::pull(.data$cell_type)
heart_H_data$cell_type <- factor(heart_H_data$cell_type, levels = heart_H_order)
heart_H_sig <- heart_rho$sig_result |>
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type = factor(.data$cell_type, levels = heart_H_order), y_pos = 103)

p_heart_H <- ggplot2::ggplot(heart_H_data,
  ggplot2::aes(x = .data$cell_type, y = .data$rho_percent, fill = .data$Group)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.72),
    width = 0.56, linewidth = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.95) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(position = ggplot2::position_jitterdodge(
    jitter.width = 0.08, dodge.width = 0.72, seed = 1),
    size = 1.35, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(data = heart_H_sig,
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data$cell_type, y = .data$y_pos, label = .data$p_label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4.4, fontface = "bold") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = heart_group_fill, breaks = c("NCR", "ACR"), name = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 105), breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "rho (%)") +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"), legend.position = "top"
  )
heart_export_plot(p_heart_H, "Heart_H_sample_rho", 11.8, 5.6)
p_heart_H_zoom <- p_heart_H + ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
  limits = c(floor(min(heart_H_data$rho_percent)) - 1, 105),
  breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 2), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
)
heart_export_plot(p_heart_H_zoom, "Heart_H_sample_rho_zoom", 11.8, 5.6)
readr::write_tsv(heart_H_data, file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_H_display_data.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(heart_rho$sig_result, file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_H_unchanged_statistics.tsv"))
p_heart_H
```

# 6. Supplementary rho: same new group palette

The supplementary panels use the same blue/mauve color family. In S11A the
colors encode ZT08/ZT16, while NCR/ACR remain separate facets; the color
reuse does not imply that a condition corresponds to a single sampling time.

```{r aligned_S11B}
p_heart_S11B <- heart_saved$S11B +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = heart_group_fill, guide = "none")
heart_S11B_ids <- paste0("p", seq_len(10))
measure_aligned_heart_panels(
  ggplot2::ggplotGrob(p_heart_S11B), file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_S11B_sample_rho"),
  11, 5.3, "^panel-[0-9]+-[0-9]+[.]", heart_S11B_ids,
  split(heart_S11B_ids, rep(1:2, each = 5)), split(heart_S11B_ids, rep(1:5, 2))
)
heart_export_plot(p_heart_S11B, "Heart_S11B_sample_rho", 11, 5.3)
```

## 6.1 S11A: True ZT legend

The legend uses the verified metadata labels ZT08 and ZT16, not AM/PM.
"True ZT" denotes those original sampling labels. They represent the source
AM/PM sampling windows (06:00--10:00 and 14:00--18:00), not precisely recorded
individual collection times. The saved circular densities and window arcs
are reused without re-estimation; cell counts and phase distributions do not change.

```{r aligned_S11A, fig.width=11, fig.height=5.5}
heart_S11A_source <- readr::read_tsv(
  file.path(heart_saved_dir, "S11_A_density_source.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE
)
heart_S11A_windows <- readr::read_tsv(
  file.path(heart_saved_dir, "S11_A_sampling_windows.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE
)
heart_S11A_meta <- readRDS(file.path(heart_saved_dir, "heart_plot_inputs_20261023.rds"))$metadata
stopifnot(all(c("cell", "celltype", "Group", "ZT") %in% names(heart_S11A_meta)))
stopifnot(setequal(unique(as.character(heart_S11A_meta$ZT)), c("ZT08", "ZT16")))
stopifnot(setequal(unique(heart_S11A_source$ZT_group), names(heart_zt_fill)))
stopifnot(nrow(heart_S11A_meta) == 127942L, nrow(heart_S11A_source) == 28800L)
heart_S11A_n <- heart_S11A_meta |>
  dplyr::count(.data$celltype, .data$Group, name = "n_cells") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Group = factor(.data$Group, levels = c("NCR", "ACR")),
                lab = paste0("n=", .data$n_cells))
stopifnot(sum(heart_S11A_n$n_cells) == 127942L)

heart_S11A_polygons <- heart_S11A_source |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$celltype, .data$Group, .data$ZT_group) |>
  dplyr::group_modify(function(data, key) {
    tibble::tibble(theta = c(data$theta, rev(data$theta)),
                   radius = c(data$radius, rep(0.92, nrow(data))))
  }) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(x = .data$radius * sin(.data$theta), y = .data$radius * cos(.data$theta),
                Group = factor(.data$Group, levels = c("NCR", "ACR")))
heart_S11A_ring <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(heart_S11A_windows)), function(i) {
  theta <- seq(heart_S11A_windows$window_start[i], heart_S11A_windows$window_end[i],
                length.out = 160) / 24 * 2 * pi
  tibble::tibble(ZT_group = heart_S11A_windows$ZT_group[i],
                 theta = c(theta, rev(theta)), radius = c(rep(0.84, 160), rep(0.72, 160)))
})) |>
  dplyr::mutate(x = .data$radius * sin(.data$theta), y = .data$radius * cos(.data$theta))
heart_S11A_guide <- tibble::tibble(theta = seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 361)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(x = 1.68 * sin(.data$theta), y = 1.68 * cos(.data$theta))
heart_S11A_ticks <- tibble::tibble(hour = seq(0, 21, by = 3)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(theta = .data$hour / 24 * 2 * pi,
    x = 1.58 * sin(.data$theta), xend = 1.68 * sin(.data$theta),
    y = 1.58 * cos(.data$theta), yend = 1.68 * cos(.data$theta),
    label_x = 2.25 * sin(.data$theta), label_y = 2.25 * cos(.data$theta),
    lab = paste0(.data$hour, "h"))

heart_S11A_plots <- stats::setNames(vector("list", length(heart_celltypes)), heart_celltypes)
for (celltype in heart_celltypes) {
  heart_S11A_plots[[celltype]] <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::geom_polygon(
      data = dplyr::filter(heart_S11A_polygons, .data$celltype == .env$celltype),
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$x, y = .data$y, fill = .data$ZT_group, group = .data$ZT_group),
      alpha = 0.65, colour = NA
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_polygon(data = heart_S11A_ring,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$x, y = .data$y, fill = .data$ZT_group, group = .data$ZT_group),
      alpha = 0.95, colour = NA) +
    ggplot2::geom_path(data = heart_S11A_guide, ggplot2::aes(x = .data$x, y = .data$y),
                       colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.25) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(data = heart_S11A_ticks,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$x, xend = .data$xend, y = .data$y, yend = .data$yend),
      colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.25) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = heart_S11A_ticks,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$label_x, y = .data$label_y, label = .data$lab),
      size = 2, colour = "grey35") +
    ggplot2::geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(heart_S11A_n, .data$celltype == .env$celltype),
      ggplot2::aes(x = 0, y = 0.35, label = .data$lab), size = 1.85, fontface = "bold") +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~Group, nrow = 1) +
    ggplot2::coord_fixed(xlim = c(-2.75, 2.75), ylim = c(-2.75, 2.75), expand = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = heart_zt_fill, name = "True ZT",
      breaks = c("ZT08", "ZT16"), labels = c("ZT08", "ZT16"), drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::labs(title = celltype) +
    ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 7, base_family = "Arial") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 7),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 6),
      legend.position = "right", legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 5.5),
      legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.3, "cm"), legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(3, 2, 3, 2)
    )
  stopifnot(identical(unique(as.character(heart_S11A_plots[[celltype]]$layers[[1]]$data$celltype)), celltype))
  heart_export_plot(heart_S11A_plots[[celltype]], paste0("Heart_S11A_", celltype, "_true_ZT"), 7, 4.3)
}
heart_S11A_grobs <- lapply(seq_along(heart_S11A_plots), function(i) {
  grid::grobTree(ggplot2::ggplotGrob(heart_S11A_plots[[i]]),
                 vp = grid::viewport(name = paste0("heart_trueZT_", i)))
})
heart_S11A_grid <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(grobs = heart_S11A_grobs, ncol = 5)
heart_S11A_ids <- paste0("p", seq_len(20))
heart_S11A_rows <- c(split(heart_S11A_ids, rep(1:10, each = 2)),
  list(heart_S11A_ids[seq(1, 9, 2)], heart_S11A_ids[seq(2, 10, 2)],
       heart_S11A_ids[seq(11, 19, 2)], heart_S11A_ids[seq(12, 20, 2)]))
measure_heart_panels(heart_S11A_grid, file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_S11A_true_ZT"),
  11, 5.5, "^panel-[0-9]+-[0-9]+[.]", 2, 10,
  heart_S11A_rows, split(heart_S11A_ids, rep(1:10, 2)))
heart_export_plot(heart_S11A_grid, "Heart_S11A_true_ZT", 11, 5.5)
readr::write_tsv(heart_S11A_n, file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "Heart_S11A_unchanged_cell_counts.tsv"))
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(heart_S11A_source), as.data.frame(readr::read_tsv(
  file.path(heart_saved_dir, "S11_A_density_source.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)),
  check.attributes = FALSE, tolerance = 0)))
```

# 7. Integrity and reusable plot objects

```{r aligned_integrity}
stopifnot(identical(heart_reference_md5, unname(tools::md5sum(heart_reference_rmd))))
stopifnot(identical(heart_rho$sig_result,
                   readRDS(file.path(heart_saved_dir, "heart_run_phase_rho.rds"))$sig_result))
stopifnot(identical(heart_dtw$similarity,
                   readRDS(file.path(heart_saved_dir, "heart_run_dtw_similarity.rds"))$similarity))
stopifnot(identical(heart_saved$H$data$rho, heart_rho$rho_sample$rho[is.finite(heart_rho$rho_sample$rho)]))
stopifnot(all(vapply(heart_celltypes, function(celltype) {
  identical(heart_F_panels[[celltype]]$data, heart_saved$F_individual[[celltype]]$data)
}, logical(1))))
saveRDS(list(E = p_heart_E, F = p_heart_F, F_individual = heart_F_panels,
             G = heart_ht$heatmap, G_legend = heart_similarity_legend,
             H = p_heart_H, H_zoom = p_heart_H_zoom, S11B = p_heart_S11B,
             S11A = heart_S11A_grid, S11A_individual = heart_S11A_plots),
        file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "heart_aligned_plot_objects.rds"))
readr::write_tsv(data.frame(
  check = c("reference_script_unchanged", "phase_refit", "gene_fit", "tests_recalculated"),
  value = c("TRUE", "FALSE", "FALSE", "FALSE")
), file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "integrity_checks.tsv"))
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(heart_aligned_dir, "sessionInfo.txt"))
```
